en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a narrow, winding old street lined with traditional two-story houses with overhanging upper floors and wooden balconies. A person stands in the middle of the uneven, possibly cobbled road. The architecture appears Ottoman/Balkan. Printed captions in French and English describe the scene as an old street. Handwritten text on the right margin reads "VODENA".
